subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1 – Lesson 3: Grammar – Present simple and Present continuous
outcomes: I can use the Present simple for habits and routines.
I can use the Present continuous for actions happening now.
I can make questions in both tenses.

tf.s: We use the Present simple for habits and routines.
tf.why: Yes! Habits use the Present simple.

tf.s: We use the Present continuous for things happening at the moment.
"I'm reading the WOW! Quiz" is in the Present simple.
"Every week" is a time word for the Present simple.
tf.why: Right! Every week shows a routine.

tf.s: "At the moment" is a time word for the Present simple.
tf.why: At the moment goes with the Present continuous.

tf.s: "Is she play volleyball now?" is correct.
tf.why: The correct question is "Is she playing volleyball now?"

tf.s: "Does Arlo do karate every day?" is a Present simple question.
tf.why: Yes! Does + every day = Present simple.

tf.s: Majid does karate twice a week.
tf.why: Correct! Majid does karate twice a week.

tf.s: It is hot every day at the winter sports centre.
tf.why: It is cold every day at the winter sports centre.

tf.s: Arwa loves volleyball because it's a great way to make new friends.
tf.why: Yes! She meets people and makes friends.

boxes.why: Every Monday is a routine: Present simple.

boxes.q: Osama ___ to athletics club on Saturdays.
___ you learning hockey at the moment?
boxes.why: At the moment = Present continuous: Are you learning?
Present simple questions with he use Does.

boxes.q: Which word goes with the Present continuous?
boxes.why: Now shows an action happening at the moment.

boxes.q: Which word goes with the Present simple?
boxes.why: Once a week shows a habit.

boxes.q: How often does Majid do karate?
boxes.why: Majid does karate twice a week.

mcq.q: Which tense is "I'm reading the WOW! Quiz"?
We use the ___ for habits and routines.
Where is it cold every day?
mcq.why: The winter sports centre is cold every day.

mcq.q: Which group has only Present simple time words?
o: every week, once a week, after school
at the moment, after school, now

mcq.q: Make a question: Arlo / go scooting / every day?
o: Does Arlo go scooting every day?
Is Arlo go scooting every day?
Do Arlo goes scooting every day?
Does Arlo goes scooting every day?

mcq.q: Choose the correct pair: routine, then now.
o: I go to school by bus every day. I'm writing now.
I'm going to school every day. I write now.
I going to school every day. I writing now.
I goes to school every day. I'm write now.
mcq.why: Routine = Present simple; now = Present continuous.

mcq.q: Why is "He's wearing a helmet" different from "He does karate every Monday"?

o: It's a great way to meet people and make new friends.
She can do it on skis.
He don't play chess every day.
He doesn't play chess every day.
My brother plays hockey every Tuesday.
mcq.why: With he we need doesn't, not don't.
